notes: Photo markup text read: '105cm snowpack' (brace from ground to snow surface), 'Dec 31 Layer @80cm', 'Dec 5 crust layer @ 41cm', 'Basal facets and depth hoar' (arrow at the ground). A folding ruler stands in the pit corner. No date, elevation or coordinates on the image (1404x1056, no EXIF orientation).
summary: Not a profile: annotated pit-wall photo of a 105 cm snowpack with the Dec 31 layer marked at 80 cm, a Dec 5 crust at 41 cm and basal facets/depth hoar at the ground
reading_issues: The filename date 2024-10-09 cannot be a snow-pit date in this season (no snowpack in October) and is almost certainly a digit transposition of 2024-01-09: the labels match the 2024-01-09 Wawa Ridge West Aspect chart (HS 105 cm, Dec 31 layer at 80 cm, Dec 5 crust at 39-41 cm). The date 2024-01-09 and W aspect are inferred from that match, not read from the photo. Layer positions are given by text labels only (arrows point at approximate spots on the wall); hardness, grain and test data cannot be read.
description: Photo of a snow pit wall with a ruler and red hand-added labels ('105cm snowpack', 'Dec 31 Layer @80cm', 'Dec 5 crust layer @ 41cm', 'Basal facets and depth hoar'), almost certainly the same pit as the Wawa Ridge West Aspect profile of 2024-01-09; no hardness, grain or test data can be read from it.
